verdict.rationale: Lorikeet says it connects "in seconds" to your ticketing system, knowledge base, and internal tools to "seamlessly ingest data". It also says it works with existing tools with no migration, and that the agent is trained on help docs and SOPs. Together these support ingesting existing help-center content without re-authoring. Knowledge-base auditing implies articles are pulled in at scale. However, ingesting past tickets as grounding knowledge (as opposed to replaying them for simulations) and internal wikis are only vaguely implied by "internal tools". Missing for 10: named knowledge-source connectors (e.g. specific help centers, Confluence/Notion wikis), explicit evidence that past tickets are ingested as agent knowledge, documentation of sync/refresh behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
